reviewer: Codex visual review of actual 4 fps and 2 fps source/input contact sheets after inference
method: Unmodified native-video Qwen3 labels, reasons, pair citations and limitations. Independent frozen seven-action baseline was not supplied to the model.
report_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False

actions.note: 0 and 0.5s show soap dispensing; 1.5-10.5s show foamy rubbing without a visible water stream. Around 11s the source transitions to rinsing, which is clear at 12-12.5s. One broad washing action merges three baseline steps and claims flowing water across their cited frames.
13-13.5s include the transition and reaching toward the dispenser; 14-15s support paper retrieval. 15.5-19.5s show drying with the towel, not continued retrieval.

20-20.5s show the departure/crossfade, and 21-21.5s show holding the door handle through paper. These cited frames do not show hand drying or discarding. The bin scene at 22-22.5s is supplied but never cited.

reference_flow.sequence: soap > lather > rinse > pull towel > dry > door handle > bin
reference_flow.summary: 3 coarse actions; drying/door/bin evidence wrong or missing. Full flow: UNVERIFIED.

steps.label: Soap
steps.note: No distinct soap action; source soap evidence is merged into washing and limitations incorrectly say application is not visible.

steps.label: Lather
steps.note: Broad washing includes the lather samples, but merges soap/rinse and claims flowing water across cited frames.

steps.label: Rinse
steps.note: No separate rinse action; cited rinse samples remain grouped into washing.

steps.label: Pull towel
steps.note: 14-15s support retrieval, but transition and later drying frames are also assigned to dispensing.

steps.label: Dry
steps.note: The label/reason claim tissue use for drying, but citations are departure and handle views, not the actual drying frames.

steps.label: Hold door handle
steps.note: Handle samples are attributed to drying/discarding; no distinct handle action.

steps.label: Lower towel into bin
steps.note: The reason claims discard, but never cites the supplied bin frames. Exact release is also occluded in the source.

limitations: One source video is not an accuracy benchmark.
The baseline describes visible actions, not a complete hygiene procedure.
No attention tensor, heatmap or calibrated confidence was measured.
Quantization, GPU, sampling and resolution differ from the previous Colab FP16 framewise run; this is not a controlled modality-only accuracy comparison.
The 92-frame whole input was stopped before response; the successful whole report uses 46 frames at 2 fps.
